issue.title: Machine-tab glossary strand still says the default tab renders as ⌨ local
issue.description:
## Memory update

- **Path:** `glossary/machine-tab.md`

The local-machine-tab-label plan relabels the default machine tab: it now renders as `⌂ <machine name>` (the viewer's `id.machine_name`, `⌂ local` fallback when unset) with the teal home indicator, and a remote alias that collides with the local name (case-insensitive, plus a literal `local`) renders as `⌨ <alias>·remote`. Update the strand to state this rule.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Update the machine-tab strand so it says the default tab renders as home-glyph plus machine name (the viewer's id.machine_name, home-glyph local when unset) with teal home styling, and that a colliding remote alias renders with the remote suffix rule.

issue.creation_reason: The local-machine-tab-label plan relabels the default machine tab to home-glyph plus machine name; the glossary strand must say so or it misleads tab-strip work.
